description.zh: 自动爬取竞品价格、上新、舆情数据，对比历史快照生成异动报告，定时推送到飞书/企微群
description.en: Auto-scrape competitor pricing, launches, and sentiment — delivers change alerts to IM groups

welcome_message.zh: 👋 你好！我是竞品情报专家。告诉我你想监控哪些竞品的 URL，我会帮你每天定时爬取、分析异动、生成报告推送到群里。
welcome_message.en: Hi! I'm your competitor intel specialist. Send me the URLs you want to monitor and I'll crawl them, flag anomalies, and push daily alerts.

description.zh: 爬取我关注的竞品，列出今天的价格变动、新上架商品和负面评论
description.en: Scrape tracked competitors, list today's price changes, new launches, and negative reviews

prompt.zh: 请用 competitor-crawler 插件爬取我之前分享的所有竞品 URL，对比最近一次快照，生成异动报告。
prompt.en: Use competitor-crawler to scrape all competitor URLs I shared earlier, diff against the last snapshot, and generate an anomaly report.

description.zh: 告诉我竞品 URL 和名称，我会把它加入监控列表
description.en: Send me a competitor URL and name and I'll add it to your watch list

prompt.zh: 帮我把 https://item.jd.com/XXXX.html 这个竞品加到监控列表，商品名叫「XX 品牌 YYY」。
prompt.en: Add https://item.jd.com/XXXX.html to the watch list, product name 'Brand X Model Y'.

description.zh: 每天早上 08:00 自动爬取竞品，异动报告推送到飞书/企微群
description.en: Automatically scrape competitors at 08:00 daily and push the anomaly report to IM

prompt.zh: 帮我创建一个每天 08:00 执行的 Cron 任务：爬取我监控的所有竞品，生成异动报告，推送到我的飞书群。
prompt.en: Create a daily 08:00 cron job: scrape all my monitored competitors, generate an anomaly report, and push it to my IM channel.

description.zh: 查看某个竞品过去 7 天的价格快照历史和走势
description.en: View a competitor's 7-day price history and trend

prompt.zh: 帮我查看「XX 品牌 YYY」过去 7 天的价格快照历史，价格是涨了还是跌了？
prompt.en: Show me the 7-day price snapshot history for 'Brand X Model Y' — is it up or down?

zh: 每天「08:00」自动爬取我监控的 5 个竞品，对比历史快照生成异动报告，推送到飞书群。价格 ±10% 或销量 ±30% 才算异动。
每个工作日「18:30」扫描竞品评论区，识别评论数暴涨的商品（评论日增 ≥ 50 条），标记出来。
每周一「09:00」生成一份竞品周报：过去一周的价格变动、上新商品、舆情趋势，汇总成 Markdown 推群。
每两小时检查一次竞品 URL 是否可访问，如果连续 3 次爬取失败就告警。
每天「10:00」只爬取新上架监控（新标题），跳过已上架商品，节省 token。
en: Every day at 08:00, auto-scrape my 5 monitored competitors, diff against history, push an anomaly report to Feishu. Price ±10% or sales ±30% counts as anomaly.
Every weekday at 18:30, scan competitor comment sections and flag products with surging comment volume (≥50/day).
Every Monday at 09:00, generate a weekly competitor report: price moves, new launches, sentiment trends — push Markdown to IM.
Every 2 hours check if competitor URLs are reachable; alert on 3 consecutive crawl failures.
Every day at 10:00, only check for new launches (new titles), skip existing products to save tokens.
